title: PosePacket
description: Python -> Unity, UDP 127.0.0.1:52100, one UTF-8 JSON line per camera frame. y grows downward (MediaPipe convention).

seq.description: monotonic sequence; receivers drop packets that go backwards

t.description: sender wall clock, Unix epoch seconds (fractional)

ok.description: pose detected this frame; when false, lm is absent

lm.description: landmark index -> [x, y, visibility], normalized 0..1 (may exceed slightly when outside frame)
